profile.headline: Principal Engineer | Platform Architect | Platform Modernization, Production Systems & AI-Assisted Engineering
profile.summary:
I’m a hands-on Principal Engineer and Platform Architect with more than 25 years of experience turning organizational intent into engineering reality.
I’m most useful when the problem crosses boundaries: application architecture, infrastructure, data, production operations, security, developer tooling, and the way engineering work gets done. I’ve modernized mature platforms, built and operated business-critical systems, led engineering teams, supported customers and sales organizations, and remained hands-on throughout.
At Winthrop Intelligence, I’ve helped evolve a mature Rails application into a broader platform spanning customer products, public APIs, generated SDKs, Kubernetes infrastructure, observability, real-time services, data processing, and developer tooling. My recent work also includes practical uses of language models and agentic tools: building AI-assisted products, creating secure MCP and CLI access to production services, and helping an engineering organization adopt AI assistance without abandoning architecture, maintainability, security, or review discipline.
Earlier in my career, I built products at startups, delivered systems across a wide range of consulting clients, served as a customer-facing solutions consultant for public-sector technology, and led infrastructure and software architecture for a multi-office financial-services firm.
The common thread is broad technical responsibility. I help organizations decide what to build, how the pieces should fit together, where complexity will become dangerous, and how to modernize without damaging what already works.
I’m particularly interested in Principal or Staff Engineer, Platform Architect, Transformation Architect, developer-experience, and hands-on technology leadership roles where sound judgment matters as much as implementation.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Transformed a mature Rails application into a multi-service platform spanning public APIs, generated SDKs, AI-assisted data processing, scraping infrastructure, real-time messaging, developer tooling, and multiple customer-facing products.
- Built and launched an AI-assisted college-athletics jobs platform that uses language models to classify and normalize positions, sports, categories, compensation, experience, and work arrangements.
- Designed an OpenAPI-based service ecosystem with OAuth-secured APIs and automatically generated Ruby, Python, and TypeScript SDKs.
- Standardized the platform on modern Rails, Ruby, and Python runtimes while establishing shared authentication, structured logging, Sentry error reporting, Prometheus instrumentation, and version-controlled Grafana dashboards.
- Built secure developer and AI access through a production MCP server and signed Go CLI, including fine-grained authorization, dynamic client registration, token management, diagnostics, and automated releases.
- Operated and evolved the Kubernetes platform, centralizing deployments, ingress, databases, caches, scheduled workloads, backups, resource tuning, and disaster-recovery practices.
- Expanded engineering capacity beyond a sole-engineer operation, enabling greater focus on platform architecture, production operations, integration design, code review, and technical direction.

positions.title: CTO, Co-Founder
positions.description:
Enleiten is committed to helping your organize your workflow so you can get your work done quickly and efficiently. 

Our personal and group organizers offer collaborative task and project management, whether your colleagues use our system or their own. 

We offer case management for the financial services industry and other regulated industries, priced by user so you can get just the amount of support you need.

positions.title: Assistant IT Director
positions.description:
Manage a datacenter and distributed network of over 30 Windows 2000 and 2003 servers, a mixed dozen VMware, Linux, FreeBSD and Solaris servers, and hundreds of ports worth of Foundry switches and Cisco routers in 10 locations nationwide supporting 200 users.
Develop internal applications in a variety of languages, including Java, Perl, PHP, Javascript and Ruby, accessing databases that include Oracle, SQL Server, and MySQL.
Build and maintain the Oracle 10g data warehouse and numerous specialized OLTP data stores.
Managed a VOIP rollout to HQ and the majority of our branch offices.
Saved the company millions of dollars in software licensing and hardware upgrades through aggressive deployment of virtualization and open source technologies.

positions.title: Network Engineer
positions.description:
Provided first level troubleshooting, escalations, and training in the Firewalls division of Customer Support.
Helped multinational corporations and government agencies resolve issues with both the Sidewinder and SecureZone firewalls and internal network designs to assure efficient service and high security for internal and e-commerce network requirements.
